inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the long-delayed 2009 agreement looks less like a sudden dispute and more like a pressure tactic in a system that has let negotiations drag on. The federal government’s delay clearly serves someone, while students and university staff are left to bear the cost. Now the union is warning of an indefinite nationwide strike, a threat reached at its 54th National Executive Council meeting. Whether the standoff is ever resolved, the people making these decisions won’t be the ones paying the price.

subtopics: Costs to students and university staff
